about_blocks.text: Recovery Ranch is a secluded addiction treatment center that specializes in providing holistic and evidence-based treatments for concurrent mental health disorders. The medical team at Recovery Ranch is dedicated to offering hope and recovery to those struggling with substance use disorder, especially when they are going through their darkest periods of their lives.
about_blocks.html: Recovery Ranch is a secluded addiction treatment center that specializes in providing holistic and evidence-based treatments for concurrent mental health disorders. The medical team at Recovery Ranch is dedicated to offering hope and recovery to those struggling with substance use disorder, especially when they are going through their darkest periods of their lives.

about_blocks.text: At Recovery Ranch, patients can gain a better understanding of their addiction and experiences that led to the onset of the disorder through evidence-based therapies such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical behavior therapy, motivational interviewing, and more. Our goal is to provide patients with the tools they need to develop healthy coping mechanisms and build resilience against possible relapse.

about_blocks.text: Recovery Ranch is a private, secluded addiction treatment centre that provides hope and healing to individuals struggling with addiction and concurrent mental health disorders. The compassionate team at Recovery Ranch is committed to helping patients through the darkest periods of their lives. With medically supervised detox, customized treatment plans and facilitated aftercare programs, Recovery Ranch delivers ongoing support from an expert team of staff including physicians, psychiatrists and a 24/7 nursing team.

about_blocks.text: At Recovery Ranch, patients can connect with a unique community of peers and expert support counsellors, many of whom have gone through similar journeys. This allows patients to gain a deeper understanding of their addiction and experiences while discovering more about themselves. The environment at Recovery Ranch is the perfect setting for holistic healing as patients can enjoy the natural beauty that surrounds them while indulging in the comfort of the log lodge and cabins. The team at Recovery Ranch is dedicated to providing personalized care that is tailored to each individual’s needs to help them carve a new path forward towards wholeness, health, and hope.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Recovery Ranch

faqs.question: What can I expect during treatment at Recovery Ranch?

answer_blocks.text: You can expect an evidence-based treatment plan tailored specifically to your needs. The plan may include holistic therapies, individual counseling, family therapy, and support groups among others.
answer_blocks.html: You can expect an evidence-based treatment plan tailored specifically to your needs. The plan may include holistic therapies, individual counseling, family therapy, and support groups among others.

faqs.question: Who will be responsible for my healthcare during my stay at Recovery Ranch?

answer_blocks.text: At Recovery Ranch, your healthcare will be overseen by our medical team, consisting of physicians, psychiatrists, and a 24/7 nursing team.
answer_blocks.html: At Recovery Ranch, your healthcare will be overseen by our medical team, consisting of physicians, psychiatrists, and a 24/7 nursing team.

faqs.question: Will my family be able to visit me while I am in treatment?

answer_blocks.text: Yes, Recovery Ranch encourages visits from family and friends. Visiting hours are established, and your therapist can provide you with more information.
answer_blocks.html: Yes, Recovery Ranch encourages visits from family and friends. Visiting hours are established, and your therapist can provide you with more information.

faqs.question: How long is the treatment process at Recovery Ranch?

answer_blocks.text: The length of stay depends on the severity of the addiction and individual patient needs. After the initial assessment, we work with you to create a customized treatment plan.
answer_blocks.html: The length of stay depends on the severity of the addiction and individual patient needs. After the initial assessment, we work with you to create a customized treatment plan.

faqs.question: What is the cost of treatment at Recovery Ranch?

answer_blocks.text: The cost of treatment differs depending on the level of care and the services you receive. OUr admissions team will provide you with more information.

answer_blocks.text: Patients are encouraged to take time off work to focus on treatment. However, we understand that individual patients’ situations are different; our team will work with you to ensure you receive the support you need.
